extracted_decision.rationale: The Manager wants every session ruling preserved as a replayable decision and the manager profile sample kept current so future autopilot consults decide as he would.
extracted_decision.summary: Save every Manager decision from the session as a manager decision record and update the manager-decision profile sample.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Bulk recording adds many records at once, including near-duplicate standing orders across tasks; profile updates still require the review gate before any identity change lands.
